name: Payment approval
purpose: Decides whether a payment request is approved. Send a role (clerk or manager), an amount and a limit; it answers approved or refused, and invalid request for anything else.
claim: PA-01: the app never approves a clerk's payment whose amount exceeds the limit. PA-02: it always approves a manager's payment.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  role = manager           → approved
  amount ≤ limit           → approved
  otherwise                → refused
proposition.plain: A manager is always approved. Anyone else is approved only up to their limit.

theorems.name: inv001Holds
theorems.statement: no request with role clerk and amount > limit is judged approved
theorems.how: Proved by linear arithmetic, checked by the Lean kernel on the UOR MCP server and again by prismpm verify in CI

theorems.name: inv002Holds
theorems.statement: every request with role manager is judged approved
theorems.how: Proved by linear arithmetic, checked by the Lean kernel on the UOR MCP server and again by prismpm verify in CI
